title: Pass notifyOnNextDose into the confirmed (too-soon-acknowledged) logDose call
description: This is the second logDose call site, fired when the user confirms the TooSoonWarningDialog. It must pass through the notifyOnNextDose value that was captured in the original PendingDoseConfirmation (task-005/task-010), not a fresh default.
acceptance_criteria: The existing acknowledgeWarning = true, line is unchanged
A new argument immediately follows it: notifyOnNextDose = pending.notifyOnNextDose,
